    h2 "From basic caching to advanced acceleration"

    [code-code-block]
      text "cache-settings.json"
      icon-button "Copy the code sample"
      text: cache_settings": { ⏎ name": "api-cache", ⏎ browser_cache_settings": { ⏎ ttl": 60 ⏎ }, ⏎ cdn_cache_settings": { ⏎ ttl": 30 ⏎ }, ⏎ cache_key": { ⏎ query_string": "whitelist", ⏎ query_string_fields": ["user_id", "category"], ⏎ cookie": "whitelist", ⏎ cookie_names": ["session_id", "region"] ⏎ }, ⏎ methods": ["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"], ⏎ stale_cache": true
